key_insight: HTSCGAN improves multi-modal brain MRI translation by explicitly preserving hierarchical tumor structure during image synthesis.
clinical_relevance: Better structural fidelity in translated MRI images may support more reliable diagnosis, treatment planning, and downstream segmentation in brain tumor care.
method: Uses three Patch Contrast Modules with different patch sizes to capture tumor structure at multiple scales.
Adds a pretrained Patch Classifier to enforce patch-level structural consistency with the target image.
Uses a pretrained Structure-Aware Encoder with tumor perceptual loss to align generated tumor regions with ground truth.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports strong results on BraTS2020 and BraTS2021 for both image translation and downstream segmentation tasks.
watch_item: The approach depends on pretrained auxiliary models and tumor-region structure quality, so performance may be sensitive to training data and implementation details.
paper_title: Unified MRI Brain Image Translation via Hierarchical Tumor Structure Comparison
